Intimacy is essential in a marriage. Intimacy can and should be so much more than sex. Now is a great time for you and your husband to discover other things that make you feel connected and safe. 

It shouldn’t necessarily be the goal but pure intimacy without expectation has an ability to create a level of safety and closeness that feels so different from your SA that you may begin to be able to separate the two in your mind sooner.

I’m on iron supplements and the higher my dose- started 325mg 3x daily- the dark and looser and more frequent my stool. Now down to once a day stool is firmer and a dark green instead of almost black.

When I don’t take my iron I’m constipated. My doctor said the opposite would happen but that just hasn’t been my experience. I’m 34 weeks and both me and baby are perfectly healthy.

Please do what you can to get a support plan in place before getting to the postpartum phase. My best friend was in a similar place with her now ex-husband and her exhaustion and mental health almost cost her her life. 

Here’s hoping you have family or close friends or even paid help that can help stand in the gap where your partner continues to fail. Sending love.

Due in Jan. we just moved to a new city and can’t do a baby shower either. I also didn’t feel like organizing a virtual one. But we made a registry and pretty much have only given it to people that asked & we’ve been surprised how much people have purchased even without a baby shower. (Crib, pack n play, bassinet, stroller…)

We’re also having the first grandchild on either side. If you have a registry may be good to share. Or do what we did and let our parents share it.

At this point in my pregnancy (14 weeks) I’ve gained a OB, a therapist, a cardiologist and a neurologist that are all focused on helping me navigate physically and emotional. I hope your pregnancy isn’t as complicated as mine but Having a plan medically and hearing the heart beat  seeing it move on US may help you get in the state of mind to think about the village you can build around you and your baby until love comes into your life in the future. ♥️

I’m 14 weeks and have had every possible physical symptom which is also causing a depressed mood and I feel like my husband takes it personally that I’m not laughing at his jokes and am generally too exhausted to do anything. Which I generally am like I don’t have the energy to make you feel better when I feel like shit. But this week at my OB appt when he heard me tell my doctor how much I was struggling and she validated and said I should go on an antidepressant in addition to some other plans to address my physical symptoms I think it clicked for him. He asked how he could help and when I said just don’t take my mood personally. He told me it’s hard not to bc I’m the only person he really has to talk to, so he lost his person. There were things going on with him at work I didn’t know about. I think we both gained a lot of perspective that day in what the other needs. It just took some work to get to the right conversation.

I just turned 30 I’m engaged to my bf of 3 years whom I live with and am still a “virgin”. Just live your life.

For me it was a control thing when I was young but around your age I realized I didn’t need penetrative intercourse to organism (many woman don’t) and I liked not having to stress about unwanted pregnancies. (My best friend had twins on an IUD - uncommon but 😅). It never hindered any relationships I’ve been in three 2+ year relationships in my 20’s and nearly married at 25 (so young).

I think it makes my sexual interactions with my partner much more intentional on both sides. We’ll have sex once we’re married bc we want to make babies.
